_comment: Per-row outcome class overrides for the Excel shadow runner. Keyed by '<sheetName>:<rowId>'. Each entry is { componentIndex, outcomeClass, reason }. Overrides take precedence over the heuristic classifier in classifyScenario.ts. Add an entry only when the heuristic gets a row wrong; the build-time report tracks how many overrides exist as a signal of heuristic accuracy.

Specific Scenarios:SPC-99999.reason: Row has a PI% but the description is ambiguous between two clinical interpretations; the assistant should ask before calculating.
